title: Speaking — Following instructions
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on following instructions.

questions: Where do you usually go if you need to study or read?
Do you prefer to learn in the morning or evening?
How do you keep track of what you have learned?
What helps you get back to studying after a break?
Do you read instructions before using something new?
Do pictures or written instructions help you more?

part2.topic: Describe a time when clear instructions helped you do something unfamiliar.
points: what made them easy to follow
part2.closing: and explain why the experience changed your view of instructions.

questions: How can companies make support documents accessible to speakers of different languages?
When should institutions offer human assistance as well as written instructions?
How has everyday life connected with following instructions changed for people of different ages?
